hero_title: Turn your WhatsApp into a customer service employee that never sleeps
hero_desc: Connect your project, connect your WhatsApp, and let it reply to your customers with your real information — prices, appointments, location — and if it doesn't know, it says so and transfers the conversation to you.
source_title: Where do we pull project information from?
source_desc: If you have a website or store, the employee knows the prices and details from it.
source_phone_hint: Save in full international format E.164 — example: +966
source_meta: Connection via official WhatsApp — Cloud API directly from Meta.
channels_title: All your messages in one place
channels_desc: Manage your customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook through one dashboard, and let AI agents help you reply, follow up, and serve customers.
channel_whatsapp_desc: Connect your business number, receive customer inquiries, and activate the AI agent to reply based on your business information.
channel_instagram_desc: Connect your business's professional Instagram account, collect incoming messages in a unified inbox, and use AI to help your team serve customers.
channel_facebook_desc: Connect the Facebook pages you manage, receive Messenger messages on your platform, and manage customer conversations without switching between apps.
features_link_meta: Connection relies on WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) from Meta, and fees and messaging policies are subject to Meta's terms.
features_ig_link: Messaging support requires a qualified professional Instagram account and appropriate Meta permissions.
features_fb_link: Messaging is linked to qualified Facebook pages and approved app permissions.
how_step1_desc: Log in via official Meta and connect assets.
how_step2_desc: Activate WhatsApp, Instagram, or Facebook according to your business.
how_step3_desc: Customize an AI agent for each channel or account.
how_step4_desc: Give the agent your business information sources.
how_step5_desc: Receive all conversations in one organized page.
how_step6_desc: Track your team and agent performance from the same dashboard.
how_unified_desc: All messages from all channels arrive in the same place — with visual source distinction, an agent per channel, and a human team ready to intervene when needed.
guarantees_badge: Why trust it with your customers?
guarantees_title: Guarantees are built into the system, not just promises
guarantees_desc: We don't ask you to trust us — these are six safeguards working on every message, before it reaches your customer.
guarantee_1_desc: The employee reads from your Google card, your website, and what you write — nothing else. It has no general knowledge to reply from about your project, so it's impossible to invent a price or service you don't have.
guarantee_2_title: Every reply is checked before sending
guarantee_2_desc: Before the reply reaches the customer, it goes through a check that prevents any price, appointment, or promise you haven't authorized. If it tries to invent, the reply is replaced and doesn't reach the customer.
guarantee_3_title: Doesn't know? Says it doesn't know
guarantee_3_desc: If asked about something you don't have confirmed information on, it says so clearly and offers to transfer the customer to you — instead of guessing and getting you into trouble with promises.
guarantee_4_desc: A complaint, refund, or any request needing your decision: the employee stops and transfers the conversation to you immediately instead of acting on its own.
guarantee_5_title: You see every question it couldn't answer
guarantee_5_desc: Every question it couldn't answer is recorded and shown in your dashboard, so you add the missing information and it becomes more accurate over time.
guarantee_6_title: You don't pay for a reply that didn't arrive
guarantee_6_desc: Deduction happens after the reply is actually delivered. If sending fails, nothing is deducted — and deduction is never repeated for the same message.
demo_title: Watch it reply… and watch it stop when it should
demo_desc: The conversation you see illustrates the difference between an employee replying "any nonsense" and an employee connected to your data: it answers accurately, admits when it doesn't know, and transfers the decision to you.
demo_1_desc: The price and times in the conversation are recorded in the project card — not made up. Notice the precision: 18 dinars, 7 AM – 1 PM.
demo_2_title: The most important message on the whole page
demo_2_desc: They asked about a branch that doesn't exist in the data, so it said "I don't have confirmed information" instead of inventing a branch that would get you into trouble.
demo_3_desc: The moment it reached the limit of its information, it stopped auto-reply and transferred the conversation to a human employee — you're always the decision-maker.

faq_a1: Yes, the connection is 100% official. We use the official WhatsApp Cloud API from Meta directly — the same channel approved for businesses, without linked devices or a browser. The connection is stable and secure and doesn't rely on your personal device.
faq_q2: How does it handle questions it doesn't have answers for?
faq_a2: Here Social Admin employee excels: instead of guessing or inventing, it clearly says "I don't have confirmed information" and offers to transfer the conversation to a human employee or directly to you.
faq_a3: No. You pay 40,000 IQD one-time payment including creating and training the employee + 1,000 smart replies. After that, you only top up credit when you need — one by one.
faq_a4: From the moment you enter your project information to the first real reply to your customer: usually less than 10 minutes. Reading from Google Maps or your website happens automatically, and you can review and edit the knowledge card before launch.
faq_q5: Does it transfer the conversation to me?
faq_a5: Yes, in three ways: if the customer explicitly requests it, if it reaches a question it doesn't have confirmed information on, or if the case is sensitive (complaint, refund, financial decision). In all cases it stops auto-reply immediately and sends you the full context.
faq_a6: Yes — any project with recurring questions: prices, appointments, location, delivery, refund policy. Your employee replies from your data, so each business's details are reflected accurately in its answers.
faq_q7: Does it need a private WhatsApp number?
faq_a7: Yes. WhatsApp requires a business number via WhatsApp Business Platform, Instagram requires a qualified professional account for messaging, and Facebook requires a business page you manage with appropriate permissions on the Meta app.
faq_q8: Can I connect more than one account?
faq_a8: Yes, you can connect more than one Facebook page, more than one Instagram account, and more than one WhatsApp number, and manage all from the same platform with clear distinction for each source.
faq_a9: Yes. A professional Instagram account is usually linked to a Facebook page through Meta's structure, and both channels can be activated together so messages arrive in the unified conversations inbox.
faq_q10: Can I customize an agent per channel?
faq_a10: Yes — you can customize the agent and knowledge source for each channel or account: for example, a sales agent for a Facebook page, a support agent for an Instagram account, and a booking agent for a WhatsApp number.
faq_q11: What happens if the connection expires?
faq_a11: Access tokens issued by Meta may expire. When that happens, auto-reply for that channel stops and an alert appears in the dashboard with official re-authorization steps to resume work.
